About

People-first design, curious about what AI makes possible.

I'm a product designer with 10+ years of experience across visual design, UX, UI, and user research. I studied Graphic Design and later completed a postgraduate diploma in Product Design, looking to understand not just how a product looks, but how it feels to use.

Throughout my career I've worked mainly with consulting firms, designing SaaS products and B2B/B2C e-commerce platforms for large-scale clients. Today my focus is on AI-powered product experiences: I firmly believe artificial intelligence is here to stay, and that we're still in the early, exploratory stage of everything it makes possible. Discovering those boundaries is something I'm deeply passionate about — and the same goes for product design in general, building tools that make the interaction between people and the technology they need feel effortless.

My approach

I don't apply the same playbook every time. For every project I run a diagnostic based on the goal, scope, and information already available, and build a custom methodology plan tailored to those needs — but always, always, grounded in user-centered design.
